pages.task: Redraw the ARCHER body, idle pose. It must read as an ARCHER at first glance: agile and light. Light comfortable clothing (thin leather vest or short tunic, sleeveless or rolled sleeves, open range of motion), slim athletic build, archer's bracer on the LEFT forearm, 3-finger archer's glove on the RIGHT hand, thin belt, soft boots, light weight-forward stance, predatory hunter's gaze. NO armor, NO brigandine, NO quilting, NO cape, NO peasant/worker feel. NO hood (head uncovered), NO quiver/arrows/fletching on body, empty hands, no weapon, strictly medieval, palette must not be green/stone-moss (Druid). Image 1 = old Archer: keep its EXACT pose, agile forward-leaning stance, scale, canvas 584x454, feet position. Image 2 = Druid (must differ). Real transparent background. CONCEPT: Forest hunter: brown-rust leather vest over a linen shirt, hair in a ponytail, light stubble, tan leather bracer and glove.
